verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's docs say it natively ingests OpenTelemetry over OTLP (gRPC, HTTP/protobuf, HTTP/JSON). They also state that apps already instrumented with OpenTelemetry can send OTLP data directly, so standard OTel instrumentation works without code changes. Honeycomb also steers users off its proprietary Beelines and other legacy instrumentation onto OTel SDKs, which supports the instrument-once, portable-backend model. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of backend-neutral routing or switching away (e.g., Collector-based fan-out to multiple backends), and independent or hands-on corroboration of migrating between backends without re-instrumenting.
